$description: Statutory facts for the State-fact post family and the deck's State-requirements master. Each fact carries its statute, the source actually consulted, and the date. No figure here is typed from memory; each was checked on the date shown. The DOI consumer pages for ID, NV and UT refused automated connections on 2026-09-13, so the statute text was verified through the legislature site (AZ) or the Justia statute mirror (NV, UT, ID); counsel should re-confirm against the official statute before print.

AZ.name: Arizona Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions

facts.headline: Arizona minimum auto liability
facts.fact: Arizona requires at least $25,000 per person and $50,000 per accident for bodily injury, and $15,000 for property damage, on policies issued or renewed since July 1, 2020.
facts.sourceNote: Statute text fetched from azleg.gov on 2026-09-13; quoted amounts: $25,000 / $50,000 / $15,000 for policies issued or renewed beginning July 1, 2020.

facts.headline: Nevada minimum auto liability
facts.fact: Nevada requires at least $25,000 per person and $50,000 per accident for bodily injury, and $20,000 for property damage.
facts.sourceNote: leg.state.nv.us refused the connection on 2026-09-13; amounts verified on the Justia mirror of the 2025 NRS (law.justia.com/codes/nevada/chapter-485/statute-485-185/). In force since July 1, 2018.

facts.headline: Utah minimum auto liability
facts.fact: Utah requires at least $30,000 per person and $65,000 per accident for bodily injury, and $25,000 for property damage, on policies issued or renewed on or after January 1, 2025.
facts.sourceNote: le.utah.gov refused the connection on 2026-09-13; amounts verified on the Justia mirror (law.justia.com/codes/utah/title-31a/chapter-22/part-3/section-304). The pre-2025 limits were 25/65/15; the 2025 change is why this fact must not be copied from older material.

facts.headline: Idaho minimum auto liability
facts.fact: Idaho requires at least $25,000 per person and $50,000 per accident for bodily injury, and $15,000 for property damage.
facts.sourceNote: legislature.idaho.gov refused the connection on 2026-09-13; the definition of 'proof of financial responsibility' was verified on the Justia mirror of the 2025 Idaho Code. The Idaho DOI consumer page (doi.idaho.gov/consumers/auto-insurance/required-auto-coverage/) states the same 25/50/15.
